description: This file contains shell script code for testing directory traversal handling and file listing behavior in a git repository context, including tests for untracked files, ignored files, and directory recursions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Commits a file with given content and filename within the test setup.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion and checks file outputs against expected results.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables for equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the given variable or output is empty.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to fail, used for testing known issues or edge cases.
